name: select: critical work_auth sponsorship question with custom rule is read
spec_quote: An item is read only when the question's class is critical AND its group is one of: work_auth, education, record, experience. … work_auth: any label about sponsorship, visa, work authorization, citizenship, immigration ("Will you require sponsorship?").

name: select: education and record kept in input order, contact and eeo dropped

items.label: Have you ever been convicted of a felony?

spec_quote: contact (NOT read): name, e-mail, phone, address ("Email", "First Name", "Phone"). … eeo (NOT read): gender, race, veteran, disability ("Gender", "Are you a protected veteran?"). … each item copied with a `group` field added … in input order

name: select: rule qa:1 whose human question normalises to the item label is not read
spec_quote: rule "qa:N" (a saved answer, entry N of the qa list, 1-based): NOT read when that entry's question `q`, normalised (lower case, the word "required" and "*" removed, every run of non-letters/digits/apostrophes → one space, trimmed), is equal to the item's label normalised the same way — that is the human's own answer for exactly this question.

name: select: rule qa:1 with a different question text is read

qa.q: Do you have a bachelor's degree?

spec_quote: Read otherwise (entry missing, or a different question text that the entry's pattern happened to match).

name: select: rule qa:3 with only two qa entries is read (entry missing)

items.label: Have you ever been convicted of a felony?

spec_quote: Read otherwise (entry missing, or a different question text that the entry's pattern happened to match).

name: select: leave=true and excluded rule (linkedin) are not read
spec_quote: Never read: no rule (rule empty or missing); value empty string, null or empty list; item has leave = true; type file, hidden or password; rule is one of linkedin, website, full_name, first_name, last_name, email, phone, address, city, state, zip, sms, or starts with how_heard.

name: select: file, hidden and password types are not read
spec_quote: Never read: … type file, hidden or password

name: select: null value, empty string, empty list and missing rule are not read
spec_quote: Never read: no rule (rule empty or missing); value empty string, null or empty list

name: same: null model value is never the same
spec_quote: model_value null → false.

name: same: empty rule value is not the same
spec_quote: Either side empty → false.

name: same: multi-pick values with the same picks in different order agree
spec_quote: Values may hold several picks separated by " | " (or be lists): same only when both have the same number of picks and every rule pick is the same as some model pick.

name: same: multi-pick with fewer model picks is different
spec_quote: same only when both have the same number of picks and every rule pick is the same as some model pick.

name: same: trailing bracketed note is ignored
spec_quote: Case, punctuation and spaces do not matter; a trailing bracketed note on either side does not matter ("F-1 (CPT)" = "F-1").

name: same: with options, a prefix match names the same option
spec_quote: With options: the same when both values name the same option (an exact or prefix match of the option).

name: same: with options, two different options are not the same
spec_quote: Otherwise different ("Bachelor" vs "Master's", "Yes" vs "No", "University of Chicago" vs "Hyde Park").

name: same: bare month name equals its number
spec_quote: A bare month: names and numbers are the same ("September" = "Sep" = "09" = "9").

name: same: numbers with trailing zeros are the same value
month: abbreviated month with punctuation
month: out-of-range number is null
spec_quote: month: … "13" → null, "2027" → null.

name: ym: month-name date with day and year
ym: bare year has a null month
spec_quote: ym: … "2027" → [2027, null]; "soon" → null.

name: enabled: nothing set means disabled
spec_quote: otherwise true when CX_WHOLE_READ = "1" or CX_SECOND_OPINION = "1"; else false.

name: enabled: CX_WHOLE_READ=0 disables
spec_quote: false when env CX_WHOLE_READ = "0", or JSA_NO_PUSH is set (non-empty), or CX_DATA is set (non-empty).

name: enabled: second-opinion flag turns it on
spec_quote: otherwise true when CX_WHOLE_READ = "1" or CX_SECOND_OPINION = "1"; else false.

name: read_items: model answer meaning the same as the rule value (case-insensitive)
spec_quote: same(rule value, model answer) → agree true, how "same".

name: read_items: UNSURE from the model stops the question
spec_quote: "UNSURE" or an empty answer = no answer. … no answer → agree false, how "unsure".

name: read_items: failing model call yields error

items.label: Have you ever been convicted of a felony?

spec_quote: The call raised an error → agree false, how "error".

name: read_items: disagreeing item WITH options gets no meaning call even if meaning is supplied
spec_quote: Only for a "disagree" item WITHOUT options: a second model call judges whether the two answers mean the same thing … Items with options never get the second call.

name: read_items: disagreeing free-text item rescued by meaning SAME

items.label: Have you ever been convicted of a felony?

spec_quote: SAME → agree true, how "meaning".

name: read_items: disagreeing free-text item with meaning DIFFERENT stays disagree

items.label: Have you ever been convicted of a felony?

spec_quote: DIFFERENT → stays "disagree".
